svg.title: Male anatomy · Half-transparent
svg.desc: Full-body anterior male anatomical mannequin divided at the median plane, with an intact external half and a transparent half exposing the brain, skeleton, major muscles, vessels, thoracoabdominal organs, urinary tract, prostate, and simplified internal reproductive tract. Design basis: The shared pose and split direction support direct comparison with the female figure while retaining male pelvic anatomy and neutral publication-oriented presentation.
